page.overview:
Who is Lady Seinia of Muscovy?

Lady Seinia of Muscovy is a tenth-generation Ventrue Grail Knight. She survives into the modern era and becomes a member of the .

In the s, malevolent spirits ravaged mortal estates across the less-tamed reaches of the Republic of Novgorod. Seinia, who had spent a century serving as the night mistress of a mortal fiefdom in the region, watched her mortal herd perish before fleeing. Having cared for her people, their deaths awakened a strong desire for justice. Two years after leaving Russia, she was rescued from brigands by an entourage of the Order of the Grail on other business. Upon hearing her story, the order agreed to help her. With Seinia acting as their anchor, they hunted and destroyed the predatory spirits over the course of a year.

Having proven her courage and competence, Seinia requested to remain with the order. Working with them offered a new purpose after the destruction of her mortal flock. Following several years of service as a squire, she became one of the few women to receive the Grail Embrace. She travels on behalf of the order to gather intelligence from the women of the Dark Medieval world who might otherwise remain silent in the presence of men. Suspecting that a powerful vampire orchestrated the destruction of her homeland, she also gathers leads regarding monsters operating within Russia.

Seinia guides the order through difficult times, making the harsh compromises necessary for survival. When the Inquisition rages, she initially fights to uphold the ideals of the Grail before ultimately bartering holy relics in exchange for safe passage back to Russia. These compromises diminish the mystical benefits of the Grail Embrace within her blood until she regresses to a standard Ventrue childe once more. When the Sabbat rises, she embraces it as a new framework to give meaning to her inhumanity, trading lofty religious chivalry for the Path of Honorable Accord. She eventually flees to the Americas as a and survives into the modern era.
